about_the_game:
Congratulations! You are a caveman. Unfortunately, that means you know absolutely nothing. Fire? A myth. Wheels? Never heard of ‘em. Basic survival? Let’s just say natural selection is watching closely.

In Sticks and Stones, everything is ruled by physics. That heavy boulder? You’re not lifting it alone or, you know, invent something useful (hint: levers exist). Every step forward is a tiny victory, and every failure is a physics lesson you won’t forget (especially if it involves fire).

Master the Basics – Discover fire, make tools, and figure out how to not starve.

Physics-Driven Gameplay – Objects have real weight, meaning teamwork and clever inventions are key.

Accidental Innovation – Stacking rocks? You just made a wall. Rolling a log? You might’ve just discovered the wheel.

Comedic Struggle – Learning is hard, and sometimes that means watching your carefully built shelter collapse in real time.

Multiplayer Mayhem

Why struggle alone when you can struggle together? Bring your friends and experience the true chaos of primitive teamwork. Need to move a giant log? Great! Just hope Dave doesn’t trip over it and send it rolling into the fire. Planning to build a sturdy shelter? Fantastic! But maybe don’t let Gary place the roof.

Whether you’re working together like early humanity’s finest engineers or accidentally inventing slapstick comedy, multiplayer brings a whole new level of prehistoric pandemonium. Will you evolve as a tribe? or descend into club-swinging anarchy?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 3GB, AMD RX 470 4GB, Intel UHD graphics 630
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 2070 6GB, AMD RX 580 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: A physics-based survival game where every discovery feels like a first. Smash, stack, and punch your way through the dawn of civilization as you learn to harness fire, craft tools, and outwit nature (or fail hilariously trying).
